================================================================================

APPROVED PATTERNS: 3

Pattern 1: HOME
- Description: Detects when HOME screen loads successfully
- Pattern: QMS Bookmark.*HOME_TILES.*load.*complete|App focus...
- File: /opt/logs/sky-messages.log
- Submitted by: system

Pattern 2: Network_Error
- Description: Detects network connectivity errors
- Pattern: MS:EPG Set new panel gadget.*tiles-disconnected.*|...
- File: /opt/logs/sky-messages.log
- Submitted by: system

Pattern 3: Process_Crash
- Description: Detects when any process crashes
- Pattern: Process crashed.*
- File: /opt/logs/core_log.txt
- Submitted by: system

All patterns immediately available for use.
